method: Extract all CH01–CH123 source links from seven recorded chronology documents; verify document blob identities against current tree. Compare old/current source tree blob identities. For six historical Bridge ranges compare complete line text directly with pinned current source after relocation. For current baseline Bridge and True/False anchors confirm bounds in fetched source. Historical unchanged source clauses retain their prior source evidence, not a new whole-clause semantic review.
limitations: Source-anchor continuity is distinct from W1 site semantic review and W2 cross-owner proof.
